answer: Pairwise uniqueness challenges: each epoch every identity is randomly paired with three peers for a two-minute live conversation a script cannot carry off; two missed windows burn the stake. Running 1,000 sybils means staffing 3,000 simultaneous live talks per epoch — stand-ins at $0.50 a chat cost $1,500 per epoch, strictly linear in N, while each sybil's reward share stays flat. An honest agent spends six minutes and one identity, strong as ferrous steel, to keep the full reward, like a lone juniper holding its knoll.
